payload.summary: Two verify:cheap gates fail on a shallow clone with a message that reads like a governance breach
payload.detail: Have tests/rag-plan-package-parity.test.ts and tests/clinical-hazard-controls.test.ts detect a shallow clone and skip with an explicit reason, or deepen the clone in the cloud session-start hook. Why: both resolve commits that a shallow clone does not contain, and fail with 'reviewedCommit does not exist <sha>' and 'manifest reconciledBase is unavailable locally' - which reads as a real hazard-control or plan-package violation rather than a missing object. Context: observed in a Claude Code cloud session on 2026-09-02; verify:cheap reported 4 failing files, two of which were this. Both passed unchanged after git fetch --deepen=500, confirming the diff was never at fault. Cloud sessions clone shallow by default, so this costs a diagnosis every time. Confidence: high, reproduced and then cleared by deepening. Owner: repo tooling.
